label: published figures and survey aggregates; no respondent-level rows
type: COMPUTED from published figures and survey aggregates

base_gdp_growth_rate.source: World Bank WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG (GDP growth, annual %), Tanzania, mean of 2021-2025

base_population.source: Census 2022 10% sample total 61,817,720 (x10), projected to 2024 with the mean WDI population growth 2.92% a year (2021-2025)

base_working_age_population.source: Census 2022 10% sample, ages 15-64 (x10: 33,043,870), projected to 2024 with the same growth

base_registered_taxpayers.source: TRA registered taxpayers, Mainland, end of fiscal year 2023/24, NBS Tax Statistics Report 2023/24 Table 3.1 (source TRA). Registered taxpayers = taxpayers registered with the Tanzania Revenue Authority (TIN holders on TRA's register), Tanzania MAINLAND only (Zanzibar is administered by ZRA), as a STOCK at the end of the fiscal year (July-June), in thousands. NBS reprodu

base_mobile_money_users.source: FinScope Tanzania 2023, weighted number of ADULTS (16+) who use mobile money (MM flag; 7,046 of 9,915 respondents, 71.6% of adults): persons, not accounts. Replaced the Bank of Tanzania active-account count (63,207,569 accounts in 2024, now a context figure only) and the typed 35,000,000 (UNKNOWN).

base_adult_population.source: FinScope Tanzania 2023, weighted number of adults aged 16 and over (9,915 respondents; Mainland and Zanzibar): the universe of the twin's registrations and mobile-money users, which can never exceed it

twin_growth_adult_population.source: World Bank WDI SP.POP.GROW, mean 2021-2025 (2.92% a year): the adult population is assumed to grow with the total population

base_mobile_money_gdp_pct.source: BoT value of mobile payments 2024 (TZS 198,859.29 billion, NPS Annual Reports 2024 / 2025) divided by nominal GDP 2024 (WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.CN): a gross transaction FLOW over GDP, so it can exceed 1

base_informal_worker_avg_income_tzs.source: ILFS 2024: weighted MEAN annual earnings (12 x monthly cash earnings + net business + net agricultural income) of employed persons in informal employment (ICLS-17, ilfs_indicators.classify) with positive earnings; the median is 1,800,000 TZS

base_msme_avg_revenue_tzs.source: ILFS 2024: weighted mean annual GROSS business receipts (Q87B, week or month, annualised) of self-employed persons in non-agricultural main jobs, winsorised at the 99th percentile (TZS 122,328,960); median 5,640,000 TZS. It describes household enterprises (mostly micro), not registered MSMEs: no published MSME revenue figure was found

base_new_taxpayer_mean_tax_tzs.source: Mean statutory income tax per NEW taxpayer in the twin (Block F1; replaces the flat 15% rate on the mean): the resident individual schedule (non-owners) and the presumptive schedule (business owners) applied to the DISTRIBUTION (100 quantile cells) of ILFS 2024 annual earnings of informal earners; effective average rate 10.40% of the group's mean earnings (TZS 407,215 mean tax on TZS 3,917,237 mean earnings)

base_msme_mean_presumptive_tax_tzs.source: Mean presumptive tax per household enterprise (Block F1; replaces the flat 3% rate on mean receipts): the presumptive schedule applied to the DISTRIBUTION (100 quantile cells) of ILFS 2024 annual gross receipts of non-agricultural self-employed with turnover; effective average rate 3.56% of mean turnover (TZS 729,529 tax on TZS 20,471,551 turnover)

twin_default_formalization_policy.source: slope of the least-squares line through TRA registered taxpayers 2017/18-2023/24 (608,107 per year) divided by the working-age population 34,999,565: new registrations per working-age adult per year in the no-policy scenario

calibration.target: TRA registered taxpayers (NBS Tax Statistics), 7 fiscal years
calibration.method: ordinary least squares, 1 free parameter (the slope) against 7 points, closed form

tra_registered_taxpayers.definition: Registered taxpayers = taxpayers registered with the Tanzania Revenue Authority (TIN holders on TRA's register), Tanzania MAINLAND only (Zanzibar is administered by ZRA), as a STOCK at the end of the fiscal year (July-June), in thousands. NBS reproduces TRA's figure and does not say whether non-business TINs, entities and dormant TINs are included: it is a count of TIN registrations, not of active or filing taxpayers and not of adults. It is therefore NOT comparable with FinScope's 1.31 million adult TIN holders (a survey estimate of ADULTS who say they hold a TIN, Mainland and Zanzibar).

cp6_definitions.note: KPI 'Number of registered taxpayers - Active: total registered active business excluding non-business TIN; a physical count of Business TIN that transacted within a year' and 'Dormant: business TIN that did not transact within a year'. Columns as I read the table: baseline 2020/21, outturn 2021/22, target 2022/23, actual 2022/23. The 2022/23 actual (1,655,920) is far below the 2021/22 outturn (3,336,777): a change of definition or measurement is implied; the plan does not explain it.

kept_separate_from.finscope_adult_tin_holders: about 1.31 million ADULTS (16+) who say they hold a TIN, weighted FinScope 2023 estimate (outputs/tables/tin_by_segment.csv); a survey estimate of persons, Mainland and Zanzibar
kept_separate_from.difference: TRA counts TIN registrations (stock, individuals and entities, business and non-business, active or dormant) on the Mainland: 6.27 million in 2023/24; FinScope counts adults reporting a TIN: the two are not the same quantity and are not reconciled

tax_base_cells.definition: Weighted quantile cells (100 cells of equal weight, ordered by the earnings variable) of ILFS 2024 earnings, 15-97 years: the statutory tax schedules are applied to every cell (src/04_models/statutory_tax.py), so the mean tax follows the earnings DISTRIBUTION, not its mean. Each cell carries the weighted mean of its respondents' variables; only cell means are published.

informal_nonowner.group: informal employment (ICLS-17, ilfs_indicators.classify), not a non-agricultural self-employed owner, positive annual earnings (cash + net business + net agricultural)

informal_owner.group: informal employment, self-employed in non-agricultural activities (owner), positive annual earnings; cells ordered by annualised gross receipts (turnover)

all_owner.group: all self-employed in non-agricultural main jobs with positive gross receipts (informal or not): the household enterprises the presumptive regime applies to

mobile_money_users_note: CONTEXT ONLY (Block E3.3): BoT counts active mobile-money ACCOUNTS (several per person possible): 63,207,569 in 2024, against 24,445,601 adults using mobile money in FinScope 2023 (7,046 of 9,915 respondents). The twin's user base is the FinScope adult count; the BoT account count and its 2019-2024 growth (x1.210 a year) are not used by the model.

tcra_corroboration_dec_accounts.note: files in data/raw/tcra/ (copied from the MultiAgent project); 2023 text figure 52.9 million; definitions change slightly over time (subscriptions registered vs active in the last three months)
